mentions.name: Shifu
mentions.description: A free and open-source, code-based CMS with an admin UI, written in Go and easy to set up. It serves as a framework for building websites with specialized features and removes the plugin-maintenance burden of WordPress-style CMSs, where plugins break on every update. A few websites have already been sold built on it.
mentions.problem: Managing a WordPress installation or similar CMS with tons of plugins is a maintenance headache, with plugins breaking on every update.
mentions.source_excerpt: Shifu (https://github.com/emvi/shifu) - a code-based CMS with admin UI. It's really easy to set up, written in Go, free and open-source, and I already sold a few websites using it. It can be used as kind of a framework to build more specialized features into a website and takes away the maintenance hell from managing a WordPress installation or a similiar CMS with tons of plugins that break with every update.
